overview_description.description:
Rabaed empowers the construction industry with a cloud-based SaaS platform, enabling cross-enterprise collaboration and digitization in construction projects. 

We offering a seamless collaboration for efficient and faster submittals, approvals and requests processing with unified visibility.

We provide the project stockholder with automated workflows for streamlined processes, supporting with localized pre-made templates for all construction process.
